summary: Iteration 3 tested end-to-end. Backend: 28/28 pytest tests pass including 7 new tests for iteration 3 (sms-status email fields, EMAIL dispatch real+invalid, timeline endpoint + 404, slots CRUD flow with duplicate skipping, booking uses clinic slots and marks slot taken). Confirmed GET /api/sms-status returns email_skonfigurowane:true, email_tryb:'REALNY', email_provider:'Resend' and SMS remains skonfigurowane:false/tryb:'MOCK'/provider:'Twilio'. POST /api/patients/{id}/remind?channel=EMAIL for delivered@resend.dev returns {ok:true, reminder:{typ:'EMAIL', mock:false, status:'WYSLANO'}}; for invalid '@example.com' returns 200 with reminder.status='BLAD' and mock:false (graceful, no 500). GET /api/patients/{id}/timeline returns pacjent, sekwencja_krok (0-3), sekwencja_krok_opis (Polish label), nastepny_krok={typ,data,krok} for mid-sequence PRZYPOMNIANY patients, przypomnienia[] with typ/krok_sekwencji/mock/status/data_wyslania, and wizyty[]. GET /api/slots empty after reset; POST /api/slots {data,godziny[]} returns {added:N} and correctly skips duplicates on re-POST; sorted response by godzina; DELETE /api/slots/{id} works. Booking: reczne_terminy=false with auto slots when no clinic slots; after adding clinic slots reczne_terminy=true and sloty exactly reflect clinic-defined dates/times; POST /api/booking/{pid}/confirm marks matching slot zajety=true with pacjent_id, patient becomes ZAPISANY, and a Potwierdzenie SMS reminder is created. Frontend: /terminy (nav-testid=nav-slots) loads with no-slots empty state; calendar day-select + pick-time-HH:MM toggles + add-slots-btn adds slots and shows slot-day-{iso} with del-slot-{id} functional; toast 'Dodano 2 terminów' confirmed. /wiadomosci sms-mode-banner shows dual cards: 'SMS: MOCK (Twilio)...' and 'Email: REALNY (Resend)...'. Patients /pacjenci row action patient-actions-{id} -> timeline-{id} opens timeline-dialog with step progress bar (SMS -> Email+3d -> SMS+7d), status badge, reminder list; for krok=2 patient (Adam Kowalski), next-step element renders 'Następny krok: SMS zaplanowany na YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM'; for krok=3 patient no next-step (correct, sequence ended). Regression: patient CRUD, filters, remind SMS/EMAIL, consent 400s, exclude/include, CSV import preview+commit, procedures CRUD, templates, settings, reminders, ROI JSON+PDF (52KB %PDF), dashboard stats, cron auth (401 wrong/missing, 200 correct + background sequence advance), sequence per-consent branching (SMS-only step1, EMAIL-only step2) all pass.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 1151 lines - splitting into routers/services modules (patients, slots, reminders, booking, cron, admin) becomes increasingly overdue for maintainability.
send_email_reminder correctly falls back to mock:false + BLAD status on invalid email/Emergent proxy failure - no 500 leaks; graceful path verified via test_email_dispatch_invalid_email_graceful.
SlotCreate accepts unrestricted godziny[]; consider server-side validation (HH:MM format + future date >= today) to defend the API when used outside the UI.
list_slots/create_slots/delete_slot have no auth. Fine for demo, but any production hardening should gate write endpoints behind admin auth (same for /admin/reset-demo).

booking_confirm marks slot via {data,godzina} match. If UI submits a slot that doesn't exist in db.slots (edge: auto-generated fallback), update_one is a no-op which is acceptable, but appointment is still created - consider validating slot existence when reczne_terminy=true to prevent bypass.
get_clinic_slots filters only zajety:false; taken slots correctly disappear from booking. Good.
test_credentials: No app auth (demo). Cron bearer read from /app/backend/.env WEBHOOK_CRON_SECRET. Resend deliverable test: delivered@resend.dev.
seed_data_creation: Ephemeral test patients (TESTEMAIL Real, TESTEMAIL Bad, TIMELINE, BOOKCL) created and deleted per-test. /api/admin/reset-demo invoked in slot/booking tests for predictable state (also clears slots).
context_for_next_testing_agent: backend_test.py has 28 tests. Iteration 3 additions (lines 335+): test_sms_status_email_fields, test_email_dispatch_real_deliverable (uses delivered@resend.dev - real send), test_email_dispatch_invalid_email_graceful (expects 200 BLAD), test_timeline_endpoint + test_timeline_404, test_slots_crud_flow (dedup on re-POST), test_booking_uses_clinic_slots (verifies reczne_terminy toggle + slot zajety + Potwierdzenie SMS). Response shape for /remind is {ok:true, reminder:{...}}; not flat. Server clock ~2026-09-19; _future_date helper uses today+N.
